seed_note: The official CLI does not expose the previous chat-completions seed control.
decision_rule: Require exactly one valid label. API/client failures and malformed labels remain unscored.
categories_1_to_4: Same GPT-6-Astra model and prompt across every compared method and backbone
category_5: Unchanged local abstention rule over 446 questions
model_blinding: The judge receives question, gold answer and candidate answer only, without model/method names or previous scores.
scope: Both newer-backbone 7-arm cohorts and all main-paper Qwen3-8B semantic LoCoMo comparisons, including depth and prompt controls
original_answers: Preserve existing predictions; rescore, do not replace them with newly generated answers
old_judgments: Retain separately; never mix different judge models in one comparison
limitation: Service alias gpt-6-astra returned a valid label via the official CLI; underlying dated snapshot unverified.
identical_stimulus_cache: Same question, gold, candidate, category, status and protocol share one blinded judgment
transport_note: One server-local worker; per-item model requests run on the server, without one SSH connection per item. Same authorized service and key.
